description: BIGSERIAL and SMALLSERIAL both collapse to sqlite3's plain INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT (sqlite3 has no separate big/small integer storage class) -- a 200 rows+json response here proves both CREATE TABLE statements and both inserts succeeded, since any failing statement earlier in the transaction would have aborted before the trailing SELECT could run

body: CREATE TABLE tB{{DLID}} (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, note TEXT)
CREATE TABLE tB2{{DLID}} (id SMALLSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, note TEXT)
